excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ẓalamnā ʾanfusanā wa-ʾin lam taghfir lanā wa-tarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina al-khāsirīna

translations.text: They said: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If thou forgive us not and have not mercy on us, surely we are of the lost!
Dediler ki: "Ey Rabbimiz! Biz kendimize zulmettik, eğer bizi bağışlamaz ve bize rahmetinle muamele etmezsen muhakkak ziyana uğrayacaklardan oluruz!"

context.summary: In the Qur’an (7:23), Adam and Hawwa turn to Allah, admitting their wrong and asking for forgiveness and mercy.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: They said ‘Our Lord we have wronged ourselves by our act of disobedience and if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us we shall surely be among the lost’.

reflection.text: Use this dua to own mistakes and ask Allah’s mercy without excuses.

en: after doing something you cannot justify
when you want to stop making excuses

title.en: Forgive me, my parents, and the believers
title.tr: Beni, anne babamı ve müminleri bağışla

arabic.text: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
arabic.fullText: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

transliteration.text: Rabbi ighfir lī wa-liwālidayya wa-liman dakhala baytiya muʾminan wa-lilmuʾminīna walmuʾmināti wa-lā tazidi aẓ-ẓālimīna ʾillā tabāran

translations.text: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
"Ey Rabbim! Bana, babama, anama, mümin olarak evime girene ve bütün inanmış erkek ve kadınlara mağfiret buyur. Zalimlerin de sadece helakini artır."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (71:28), Nuh prays for forgiveness for himself, his parents, and all believing men and women.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: My Lord forgive me and my parents — both of whom were believers — and whoever enters my house my dwelling or my place of worship as a believer and believing men and believing women to the Day of Resurrection and do not increase the evildoers except in ruin’ in destruction — and thus they were destroyed.

reflection.text: Include family and the wider ummah in your prayers for forgiveness.

en: praying for parents, living or dead
when you want to include more than yourself
tr: yaşayan ya da vefat etmiş anne baba için dua ederken

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾanzilnī munzalan mubārakan wa-ʾanta khayru al-munzilīna

translations.text: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
Ve de ki: "Rabbim! Beni mübarek bir yere indir. Sen, konuklatanların en hayırlısısın."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (23:29), Nuh asks for a blessed landing after being saved.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And say upon disembarking from the ship “My Lord cause me to land with a landing read munzalan as the verbal noun as well as the noun of place for ‘landing’; or manzilan as meaning the site of the landing blessed being that landing or place for You are the best of all who bring to land” ’ that which has been mentioned.

reflection.text: Ask Allah’s blessing when entering a new phase or place.

en: moving house
arriving somewhere new
starting again after upheaval
tr: büyük bir alt üst oluştan sonra yeniden başlarken

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
arabic.fullText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ

transliteration.text: ʾannī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir

translations.text: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
Bunun üzerine Rabbine: "Ben yenik düştüm, bana yardım et!" diyerek yalvardı.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Qamar, 54:10. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And so he invoked his Lord saying ‘I have been annī to be understood as bi-annī overcome so help me!’

en: when you have run out of your own strength
outnumbered and out of arguments
tr: sayıca ve delil bakımından yenik düştüğünüzde

title.en: Help me, for they have denied me
title.tr: Beni yalanladıkları için bana yardım et

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

transliteration.text: Rabbi inṣurnī bimā kadhdhabūni

translations.text: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
Nuh: "Rabbim! dedi, beni yalana çıkarmalarına karşı bana yardım et!"

context.summary: In the Qur’an (23:26), Nuh asks Allah for help against those who denied his message.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He Noah said ‘My Lord help me against them because they deny me’ because of their denial of me by destroying them. God exalted be He says responding to his supplication

reflection.text: Seek Allah’s help when facing rejection for truth.

en: when you are disbelieved by the people you were trying to help
tr: yardım etmeye çalıştığınız insanlar size inanmadığında

title.en: I seek refuge from asking what I do not know

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinnī ʾaʿūdhu bika ʾan ʾasalaka mā laysa lī bihi ʿilmun wa-ʾillā taghfir lī wa-tarḥamnī ʾakun mina al-khāsirīna

translations.text: He said: My Lord! Lo! in Thee do I seek refuge (from the sin) that I should ask of Thee that whereof I have no knowledge. Unless Thou forgive me and have mercy on me I shall be among the lost.
Nuh: "Ey Rabbim! Ben bilmediğim bir şeyi istemiş olmaktan dolayı sana sığınırım. Sen beni bağışlamazsan, bana merhamet etmezsen ben hüsrana uğrayanlardan olurum.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (11:47), Nuh seeks refuge after being corrected and asks for Allah’s forgiveness and mercy.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord I seek refuge in You from the sin that I should ask of You that whereof I have no knowledge. Unless You forgive me my excess and have mercy on me I shall be among the losers’.

reflection.text: Accept correction with humility and return to Allah.

en: after asking for something you should not have
when you realise you were wrong to ask
tr: istememeniz gereken bir şeyi istedikten sonra

title.en: Against those who would not stop

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
arabic.fullText: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

transliteration.text: Rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā al-ʾarḍi mina al-kāfirīna dayyāran

translations.text: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
Nûh dedi ki: "Yeryüzünde kafirlerden bir tek kişi bırakma."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (71:26), Nuh asks Allah to end persistent disbelief and corruption.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And Noah said ‘My Lord do not leave from among the disbelievers a single dweller upon the earth dayyār means ‘one who inhabits a dwelling dār’ in other words not one.

reflection.text: When oppression persists, ask Allah to establish justice while staying patient.

en: after every appeal has been exhausted

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinna qawmī kadhdhabūni faftaḥ baynī wa-baynahum fatḥan wa-najjinī wa-man maʿiya mina al-muʾminīna

translations.text: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me. Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
Nuh: "Rabbim! dedi, kavmim beni yalancılıkla itham etti." "Artık benimle onların arasında sen hükmünü ver. Beni ve beraberimdeki müminleri kurtar."

context.summary: From Sūrat Ash-Shu'araa, 26:117-118. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He Noah said ‘My Lord my people have denied me

en: when you are not believed
when the people closest to the work reject it
tr: işe en yakın olanlar onu reddettiğinde

title.en: Make this a place of safety

excerpt.note: Both the narrative introduction and the closing narration are outside the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًۭا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ
arabic.fullText: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًۭا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ قَالَ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَأُمَتِّعُهُۥ قَلِيلًۭا ثُمَّ أَضْطَرُّهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلنَّارِ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ijʿal hādhā baladan ʾāminan warzuq ʾahlahu mina ath-thamarāti man ʾāmana minhum billahi walyawmi al-ʾākhiri

translations.text: And when Abraham prayed: My Lord! Make this a region of security and bestow upon its people fruits, such of them as believe in Allah and the Last Day, He answered: As for him who disbelieveth, I shall leave him in contentment for a while, then I shall compel him to the doom of Fire - a hapless journey's end!

Ve o vakit İbrahim "Ey Rabbim, burasını güvenli bir belde kıl, halkından Allah'a ve ahiret gününe iman edenleri çeşitli meyvalarla rızıklandır" diye yalvardı. Allah buyurdu ki: "küfredeni dahi rızıklandırır da hayattan biraz nasip aldırırım, sonra da onu ateş azabına uğratırım ki, orası ne yaman bir duraktır!"

context.summary: In the Qur’an (2:126), Ibrahim prays for a secure city and provision for its believing people.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And when Abraham said ‘My Lord make this place a land secure in which there is safety God granted him his request making it a sanctuary in which no human blood is shed no injustice is committed towards anyone no prey is hunted and which is never deserted in any of its parts; and provide its people with fruits something which actually happened when there came itinerants from as far as Syria whereas before it had been devoid of any vegetation or water; such of them as believe in God and the Last Day’ this phrase stands in place of its people and they are here singled out for mention in the request in accordance with God’s saying My covenant shall not reach the evildoers; He exalted said ‘And whoever disbelieves I will also provide with fruits to him I shall give enjoyment read either umti‘uhu or umatti‘uhu by granting him sustenance in this life a little the length of his life but then I shall compel him I shall drive him in the Hereafter to the chastisement of the Fire so that he cannot find an escape — how evil a journey’s end!’ a place to which to return.

reflection.text: Pray for safety and lawful provision for your community.

en: praying for the place you live
for a city in danger

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةًۭ مُّسْلِمَةًۭ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَٱبْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
arabic.fullText: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةًۭ مُّسْلِمَةًۭ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ رَبَّنَا وَٱبْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā ʾinnaka ʾanta as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu rabbanā wajʿalnā muslimayni laka wa-min dhurriyyatinā ʾummatan muslimatan laka wa-ʾarinā manāsikanā wa-tub ʿalaynā ʾinnaka ʾanta at-tawwābu ar-raḥīmu rabbanā wabʿath fīhim rasūlan minhum yatlū ʿalayhim ʾāyātika wa-yuʿallimuhumu al-kitāba walḥikmata wa-yuzakkīhim ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu

translations.text: And when Abraham and Ishmael were raising the foundations of the House, (Abraham prayed): Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower. Our Lord! And make us submissive unto Thee and of our seed a nation submissive unto Thee, and show us our ways of worship, and relent toward us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Relenting, the Merciful. Our Lord! And raise up in their midst a messenger from among them who shall recite unto them Thy revelations, and shall instruct them in the Scripture and in wisdom and shall make them grow. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, Wise.

Ve ne vakit ki İbrahim, Beyt'in temellerini yükseltmeye başladı, İsmail ile birlikte şöyle dua ettiler: Ey Rabbimiz, bizden kabul buyur, hiç şüphesiz işiten sensin, bilen sensin. Ey bizim Rabbimiz, hem bizim ikimizi yalnız senin için boyun eğen müslümanlar kıl, hem de soyumuzdan yalnız senin için boyun eğen müslüman bir ümmet meydana getir ve bize ibadetimizin yollarını göster, tevbemize rahmetle bakıver. Hiç şüphesiz Tevvâb sensin, Rahîm sensin. Ey bizim Rabbimiz, bir de onlara içlerinden öyle bir peygamber gönder ki, onlara senin âyetlerini tilavet eylesin, kendilerine kitabı ve hikmeti öğretsin, içlerini ve dışlarını tertemiz yapıp onları pâk eylesin. Hiç şüphesiz Azîz sensin, hikmet sahibi Sensin.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (2:127), Ibrahim and Ismail ask Allah to accept their service while raising the Ka‘bah.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And mention when Abraham raised up the foundations the supports or the walls of the House building it min al-bayt ‘of the House’ is semantically connected to yarfa‘u ‘raises up’ and Ishmael with him wa-Ismā‘īlu is a supplement to Ibrāhīmu both of them saying ‘Our Lord! Receive this building from us. Truly You are the Hearing of words the Knowing of deeds.

reflection.text: Seek Allah’s acceptance for every act of worship.

en: after finishing something you built
when you want the work accepted, not just done
tr: inşa ettiğiniz bir işi bitirdikten sonra
işin sadece bitmesini değil kabul edilmesini istediğinizde

title.en: Keep me and my sons from idols
title.tr: Beni ve oğullarımı putlardan uzak tut

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
arabic.fullText: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ijʿal hādhā al-balada ʾāminan wajnubnī wa-baniyya ʾan naʿbuda al-ʾaṣnāma

translations.text: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.
Hatırla ki; Bir zaman İbrahim şöyle demişti: "Rabbim! Bu şehri güvenli kıl! Beni ve oğullarımı putlara tapmaktan uzak tut!

context.summary: In the Qur’an (14:35), Ibrahim asks Allah to secure the city and protect his family from idolatry.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī

tafsir.text: And mention when Abraham said ‘My Lord make this land Mecca secure — God granted him this petition and thus made it Mecca a sanctuary in which no human blood is shed no person is wronged prey is not hunted and one which is never deserted in any of its parts — and turn me and my sons away from serving idols.

when you fear what your family will drift toward

title.en: The prayer of the empty valley

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
arabic.fullText: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinnahunna ʾaḍlalna kathīran mina an-nāsi fa-man tabiʿanī fa-ʾinnahu minnī wa-man ʿaṣānī fa-ʾinnaka ghafūrun raḥīmun rabbanā ʾinnī ʾaskantu min dhurriyyatī biwādin ghayri dhī zarʿin ʿinda baytika al-muḥarrami rabbanā liyuqīmū aṣ-ṣalawāta fajʿal ʾafidatan mina an-nāsi tahwī ʾilayhim warzuqhum mina ath-thamarāti laʿallahum yashkurūna rabbanā ʾinnaka taʿlamu mā nukhfī wa-mā nuʿlinu wa-mā yakhfā ʿalā al-lahi min shayʾin fī al-ʾarḍi wa-lā fī as-samāʾi al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī wa-haba lī ʿalā al-kibari ʾismāʿīla wa-ʾisḥāqa ʾinna rabbī lasamīʿu ad-duʿāʾi rabbi ijʿalnī muqīma aṣ-ṣalawāti wa-min dhurriyyatī rabbanā wa-taqabbal duʿāʾi rabbanā ighfir lī wa-liwālidayya wa-lilmuʾminīna yawma yaqūmu al-ḥisābu

translations.text: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful. Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful. Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah. Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer. My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer. Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.

"Rabbim! Çünkü onlar (putlar) insanlardan birçoğunun sapmasına sebep oldular. Şimdi kim bana uyarsa, o bendendir; kim bana karşı gelirse, artık sen gerçekten çok bağışlayan ve çok merhamet edensin. "Rabbimiz! Ben çocuklarımdan bir kısmını namazı dosdoğru kılmaları için, senin Beyti Haram'ının yanında, ekinsiz bir vadiye yerleştirdim. Artık sen de insanlardan bir kısmını onlara meylettir. Ve onları bazı meyvelerle rızıklandır ki şükretsinler. "Ey Rabbimiz! Sen bizim gizlediğimizi de açığa vurduğumuzu da şüphesiz bilirsin. Çünkü yerde ve gökte, hiçbir şey Allah'tan gizli kalmaz. "İhtiyarlık halimde bana İsmail'i ve İshak'ı lutfeden Allah'a hamd olsun. Şüphesiz ki Rabbim duamı çok iyi işitir. "Ey Rabbim! Beni ve soyumdan gelecekleri namazını dosdoğru kılanlardan eyle! Ey Rabbimiz! duamı kabul et! "Ey Rabbimiz! Herkesin hesaba çekileceği günde beni, anababamı ve müminleri bağışla!"

context.summary: In the Qur’an (14:36), Ibrahim acknowledges the misguidance of idols and entrusts people to Allah’s mercy.

tafsir.text: My Lord truly they idols have led many of mankind astray because of their mankind’s worship of them. So whoever follows me believing in the Oneness of God verily belongs with me belongs with those who follow my religion; and whoever disobeys me truly You are Forgiving Merciful this was before he was aware of the fact that God does not forgive idolatry.

reflection.text: Hold to truth while relying on Allah’s mercy for others.

praying for descendants you will not meet

title.en: Wisdom, and to be joined to the righteous

arabic.text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
arabic.fullText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ

transliteration.text: Rabbi hab lī ḥukman wa-ʾalḥiqnī bilṣṣāliḥīna wajʿal lī lisāna ṣidqin fī al-ʾākhirīna wajʿalnī min wa-rathati jannati an-naʿīmi waghfir liʾabī ʾinnahu kāna mina aḍ-ḍāllīna wa-lā tukhzinī yawma yubʿathūna yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun wa-lā banūna ʾillā man ʾatā al-laha biqalbin salīmin

translations.text: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous. And give unto me a good report in later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight, And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err. And abase me not on the day when they are raised, The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man) Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.

"Ya Rab! Bana hikmet (hüküm) ver ve beni iyiler (zümresin)e kat." "Sonra gelecekler içinde beni doğrulukla anılanlardan eyle!" "Ve beni naîm (nimeti bol) cennetin varislerinden eyle!" "Babamı da bağışla, çünkü o yanlış gidenlerdendir. " "(İnsanların) diriltilecekleri gün, beni mahcub etme." "O gün ki ne mal fayda verir ne oğullar!" "Ancak Allah'a temiz bir kalple gelenler o günde (kurtuluşa erer)."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (26:83), Ibrahim asks for sound judgment and to be joined with the righteous.

tafsir.text: My Lord! Grant me unerring judgement knowledge and unite me with the righteous the prophets.

title.en: In You we have put our trust

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
arabic.fullText: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُا۟ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa-ʾilayka ʾanabnā wa-ʾilayka al-maṣīru

translations.text: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying.

İbrahim'de ve onunla beraber bulunanlarda sizin için güzel bir misal vardır, onlar kavimlerine demişlerdi ki: "Biz sizden ve sizin Allah'tan başka taptıklarınızdan uzağız. Sizi tanımıyoruz. Siz bir tek Allah'a inanıncaya kadar sizinle bizim aramızda sürekli bir düşmanlık ve nefret belirmiştir." Yalnız İbrahim'in babasına: "Senin için mağfiret dileyeceğim, fakat senin için Allah'tan (gelecek) hiçbir şeyi (önlemeye) gücüm yetmez." demesi hariç. Rabbimiz! Yalnız sana dayandık, sana yöneldik. Dönüşümüz de ancak sanadır.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Mumtahana, 60:4. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Verily there is for you a good example read iswa or uswa in both instances meaning qudwa in the person of Abraham in terms of his sayings and deeds and those who were with him of believers when they said to their people ‘We are indeed innocent of you bura’ā’ is the plural of barī’ similar in form to zarīf ‘charming’ and of what you worship besides God. We repudiate you we disavow you and between us and you there has arisen enmity and hate forever wa’l-baghdā’u abadan pronounce both hamzas fully or replace the second one with a wāw until you come to believe in God alone’ except for Abraham’s saying to his father ‘I shall ask forgiveness for you — this statement is excepted from ‘a good example’ so it is not right for you to follow his example in this respect by asking forgiveness for disbelievers. As for his saying but I cannot avail you anything against God’ — that is either against His chastisement or to secure for you of His reward — he Abraham is using it to intimate to his father that he can do nothing for him other than to ask forgiveness for him which saying is itself based on that former statement albeit excepted from it in terms of what is meant by it even if on the face of it it would seem to be semantically part of the good example to be followed Say ‘Who can avail you anything against God’ Q. 4811; his Abraham’s plea of forgiveness for him was before it became evident to him that he his father was an enemy of God as mentioned in sūrat Barā’a Q. 9114. ‘Our Lord in You we put our trust and to You we turn penitently and to You is the journeying these are the words of the Friend of God Abraham and those who were with him in other words they were saying

en: after a break with people you cannot go back to
when the decision is made and the cost is coming

title.en: Do not make us a trial for the disbelievers
title.tr: Bizi inkâr edenler için bir fitne kılma

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
arabic.fullText: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnatan lilladhīna kafarū waghfir lanā rabbanā ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu

translations.text: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise.
"Rabbimiz! Bizi inkar edenler için bir fitne kılma, (onlara mağlub etme!) bizi bağışla! Ey Rabbimiz! Yegane gâlib ve hikmet sahibi ancak sensin."

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Mumtahana, 60:5. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Our Lord do not make us a cause of beguilement for those who disbelieve that is to say do not make them prevail over us lest they think that they are following the truth and are beguiled as a result in other words lest they lose their reason because of us; and forgive us. Our Lord You are indeed the Mighty the Wise’ in Your kingdom and Your actions.

en: when your failure would be used against what you believe

arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi inṣurnī ʿalā al-qawmi al-mufsidīna

title.en: I complain of my grief only to Allah

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

transliteration.text: ʾinnamā ʾashkū baththī wa-ḥuznī ʾilā al-lahi wa-ʾaʿlamu mina al-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna

translations.text: He said: I expose my distress and anguish only unto Allah, and I know from Allah that which ye know not.
Dedi ki: "Ben hüznümü, kederimi ancak Allah'a şikayet ederim ve Allah tarafından sizin bilmediğiniz şeyleri de bilirim."

context.summary: From Sūrat Yusuf, 12:86. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said to them ‘I complain of my anguish — bathth is severe grief which cannot be endured unless it is proclaimed yubaththu to others — and grief only to God not to any other than Him for it is worth complaining to Him; and I know from God what you do not know and that is that Joseph’s dream is true and that he is alive. Then he said

en: grief you are tired of explaining to people
when sympathy has run out and the loss has not

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌۭ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
arabic.fullText: وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍۢ كَذِبٍۢ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًۭا فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌۭ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

transliteration.text: Fa-ṣabrun jamīlun wa-al-lahu al-mustaʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna

translations.text: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

Bir de gömleğinin üzerinde yalandan bir kan getirmişlerdi. Babaları dedi ki: "Hayır, nefisleriniz aldatmış da size bir iş yaptırtmış. Artık bana güzel bir sabır gerekiyor. Bu anlattıklarınıza karşılık yardımına sığınılacak olan ancak Allah'dır."

context.summary: From Sūrat Yusuf, 12:18. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And they came with false blood on his shirt ‘alā qamīsihi has the status of an accusative of the verb because it is an adverbial qualifier meaning fawqa qamīsihi they slaughtered a lamb and dabbed it his shirt with its blood — but they forgot to tear it the shirt — and they said that it was his blood. He Jacob said when he saw that it the shirt was undamaged and realised that they were lying ‘Nay but your souls have beguiled you into something and so you did it to him. Yet comely patience! without any anxiety! fa-sabrun jamīlun is the predicate of a missing subject such as amrī ‘my course’. And God is the One Whose succour is sought in that predicament which you describe’ that which you mention of Joseph’s affair.

en: when you have been lied to and cannot prove it
tr: size yalan söylendiğinde ve bunu ispat edemediğinizde

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱلسِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّى كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّى كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi as-sijnu ʾaḥabbu ʾilayya mimmā yadʿūnanī ʾilayhi wa-ʾillā taṣrif ʿannī kaydahunna ʾaṣbu ʾilayhinna wa-ʾakun mina al-jāhilīna

translations.text: He said: O my Lord! Prison is more dear than that unto which they urge me, and if Thou fend not off their wiles from me I shall incline unto them and become of the foolish.

Yusuf dedi ki: "Ey Rabbim! Zindan bana, bunların beni davet ettikleri şeyden daha sevimlidir. Eğer sen, bu kadınların tuzaklarını benden uzak tutmazsan, ben onların tuzağına düşerim ve cahillik edenlerden olurum".

tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord prison is dearer to me than that to which they are urging me. And if You do not fend off their wiles from me then I shall tend I shall incline towards them and become of the ignorant the sinful this is intended as a supplication which is why God exalted be He then says

en: choosing the harder option to avoid the wrong one
when temptation is also the safer path
tr: yanlıştan kaçınmak için zor olanı seçerken
günah aynı zamanda daha güvenli yolken

arabic.text: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
arabic.fullText: رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi qad ʾātaytanī mina al-mulki wa-ʿallamtanī min taʾwīli al-ʾaḥādīthi fa-ṭira as-samāwāti walʾarḍi ʾanta wa-liyyi fī ad-dunyā walʾākhirati tawaffanī musliman wa-ʾalḥiqnī bilṣṣāliḥīna

translations.text: O my Lord! Thou hast given me (something) of sovereignty and hast taught me (something) of the interpretation of events - Creator of the heavens and the earth! Thou art my Protecting Guardian in the world and the Hereafter. Make me to die muslim (unto Thee), and join me to the righteous.

"Ey Rabbim! Sen bana dünya mülkünden nasip verdin ve bana rüyaların tabirinden bir ilim öğrettin. Ey gökleri ve yeri yoktan var eden Rabbim! Benim velim sensin, benim canımı müslüman olarak al ve beni salih kulların arasına kat!" {*} Hasılı, ne zamanki, Yusuf'a vardılar, yani Yusuf'un daha önce kardeşlerine tenbih edip istediği gibi, başta babaları olmak üzere bütün aile bireyleri topluca Mısır'a gelip Yusuf'un yanına vardılar. Rivayet olunur ki, Yusuf ve Melik, yanlarında dört bin asker, birtakım devlet adamları ve Mısır halkından çok sayıda insan, gelen kafileyi karşılamaya çıkmışlardı. Yakub Aleyhisselam, oğlu Yahuda'ya dayanarak yürüyordu, karşıdan gelen kafileye ve atlılara bakıp, "Ey Yahuda, şu karşıdaki adam Mısır'ın Firavun'u mu?" diye sordu. O da "Hayır, Firavun değil, oğlun" dedi. Yaklaştıkları zaman Yusuf'dan önce Yakup selam verdi ve "Selam sana ey hüzünleri gideren" dedi{*}ilh.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (12:101), Yusuf thanks Allah for authority and knowledge and asks for a faithful end.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: When he was nearing his end realising that he would not remain alive forever he longed for the everlasting kingdom and said My Lord indeed You have given me something of sovereignty and You have taught me the interpretation of events the ability to explain dreams. Originator Creator of the heavens and the earth! You are my Protector Guardian of my best interests in this world and the Hereafter. Take me in death to You in submission to You and join me to the righteous’ from among my fathers. He lived after that for another week or more. He died at the age of 120 years. The Egyptians were very covetous with regard to his grave; eventually they placed him in a marble coffin and buried him at the top of the Nile so that both banks would be blessed by his body — Glory be to the One Whose Kingdom never ends.

reflection.text: Let blessings lead you to gratitude and a righteous conclusion.

en: after long-delayed relief finally arrives
when everything has been restored and you want to end well
tr: uzun süre gecikmiş bir ferahlık nihayet geldiğinde
her şey geri verildiğinde ve güzel bir son istediğinizde

arabic.fullText: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

translations.text: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
Eyyûb da: "Başıma bir bela geldi, (sana sığındım), sen merhametlilerin en merhametlisisin" diye Rabbine nida etti.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (21:83), Ayyub mentions his hardship and appeals to Allah’s mercy.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And mention Job Ayyūba is substituted by the following idh nādā rabbahu … when he called out to his Lord — after he had been afflicted with the loss of all of his possessions and children the laceration of his body his being shunned by all except his wife for a period of thirteen seventeen or eighteen years as well as the affliction of enduring a straitened means of livelihood — ‘Indeed read annī because of the implicit yā’ of the first person pronoun harm adversity has befallen me and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful’.

reflection.text: When tested, speak to Allah with humility and hope.

en: long illness
pain you have stopped describing to people

arabic.fullText: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ

transliteration.text: ʾannī massaniya ash-shayṭānu binuṣbin wa-ʿadhābin

translations.text: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.
Kulumuz Eyyub'u da an. Bir zaman o, Rabbine şöyle nida etmişti: "Meşakkat ve acı ile bana şeytan dokundu."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (38:41), Ayyub describes his suffering and turns to Allah for help.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And mention also Our servant Job when he called out to his Lord saying ‘Lo! Satan has afflicted me with hardship harm and suffering’ pain he attributes all this to Satan even though all things are from God to show reverence in his call to Him exalted be He.

reflection.text: Present your hardship to Allah and seek His relief.

en: exhaustion that feels like it is being aimed at you
tr: size yöneltilmiş gibi hissettiren bir bitkinlik

title.tr: Bizimle kavmimiz arasında hak ile hükmet

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا ٱفْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰتِحِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَدِ ٱفْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِى مِلَّتِكُم بَعْدَ إِذْ نَجَّىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّعُودَ فِيهَآ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَسِعَ رَبُّنَا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا ٱفْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰتِحِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā iftaḥ baynanā wa-bayna qawminā bilḥaqqi wa-ʾanta khayru al-fātiḥīna

translations.text: We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned to your religion after Allah hath rescued us from it. It is not for us to return to it unless Allah our Lord should (so) will. Our Lord comprehendeth all things in knowledge. In Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk, for Thou art the best of those who make decision.

(Andolsun ki), Allah bizi ondan (kâfirlikten) kurtardıktan sonra tekrar sizin dininize dönersek, Allah'a karşı iftira etmiş oluruz. Rabbimiz Allah'ın dilemesi hali müstesna geri dönmemiz bizim için olacak şey değildir. Rabbimizin ilmi her şeyi kuşatmıştır. Biz sadece Allah'a dayanırız. Ey Rabbimiz! Bizimle kavmimiz arasında adaletle hükmet. Çünkü sen hükmedenlerin en hayırlısısın.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-A'raaf, 7:89. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: We would be forging a lie against God if we were to return to your creed after God has delivered us from it. It is not right for us to return to it unless God our Lord wills that it be so and forsakes us. Our Lord embraces all things through His knowledge that is to say His knowledge embraces all things including my situation and yours. In God we have put our trust. Our Lord decide adjudicate between us and our people for You are the best of deciders’ adjudicators.

en: a dispute that cannot be settled between the parties
when you are pressured to go back on something
tr: bir şeyden dönmeniz için baskı gördüğünüzde

title.en: Expand my chest, ease my task

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى

transliteration.text: Rabbi ishraḥ lī ṣadrī wa-yassir lī ʾamrī waḥlul ʿuqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī

translations.text: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind And ease my task for me; And loose a knot from my tongue, That they may understand my saying.
Musa dedi ki: "Ey Rabbim! Benim göğsüme genişlik ver, İşimi kolaylaştır, Dilimden düğümü çöz Ki, sözümü iyi anlasınlar.

tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord expand my breast for me expand it so that it may accommodate the weight of the Divine Message.

before a task you do not feel equal to
before an exam or interview

title.en: I have wronged myself, so forgive me

arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

Musa, "Rabbim! Doğrusu kendimi ziyana uğrattım. Beni bağışla!" dedi; Allah da, onu bağışladı. Çünkü, çok bağışlayıcı, çok merhamet edici olan ancak O'dur.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (28:16), Musa admits his wrongdoing and asks Allah’s forgiveness.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said remorsefully ‘My Lord I have indeed wronged myself by killing him so forgive me!’ So He forgave him. Truly He is the Forgiving the Merciful that is to say the One Who has always possessed and will always possess these two attributes.

reflection.text: Admit mistakes quickly and seek Allah’s pardon.

en: after harming someone in anger
when the consequence is already irreversible

title.en: Save me from the wrongdoing people

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
arabic.fullText: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.
Musa korka korka, (etrafı) gözetleyerek oradan çıktı. "Rabbim! Beni zalimler güruhundan kurtar" dedi.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (28:21), Musa asks to be saved from wrongdoing people.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: So he departed from it fearful vigilant lest any of the pursuers catch up with him or in the hope that God might rescue him. He said ‘My Lord deliver me from the evildoing people’ Pharaoh’s people.

reflection.text: Seek Allah’s protection when facing injustice.

en: fleeing
when you are being looked for

title.en: I am in need of whatever good You send

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَقِيرٌۭ
arabic.fullText: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَقِيرٌۭ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinnī limā ʾanzalta ʾilayya min khayrin fa-qīrun

translations.text: So he watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade, and said: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.
Bunun üzerine Musa, onların davarlarını suladı. Sonra gölgeye çekildi ve "Rabbim! Doğrusu bana indireceğin her hayra muhtacım" dedi.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (28:24), Musa asks for any good that Allah sends down.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: So he watered their flock for them from another well nearby by lifting a rock from on top of it which only ten men could have lifted; then he retreated to the shade of an acacia tree samura because of the extreme heat of the sun and he was hungry and said ‘My Lord indeed I am in utter need of whatever good whatever food You send down to me’. reflection.text: Recognize your dependence on Allah’s provision.

en: broke, hungry, or without work
when you do not want to name what you need

title.en: Show me, that I may look upon You
title.tr: Bana kendini göster de sana bakayım

excerpt.note: Both the narrative introduction and the closing narration are outside the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ أَرِنِىٓ أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ
arabic.fullText: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَٰتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِىٓ أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ لَن تَرَىٰنِى وَلَٰكِنِ ٱنظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُۥ فَسَوْفَ تَرَىٰنِى فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُۥ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُۥ دَكًّۭا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًۭا فَلَمَّآ أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾarinī ʾanẓur ʾilayka

translations.text: And when Moses came to Our appointed tryst and his Lord had spoken unto him, he said: My Lord! Show me (Thy Self), that I may gaze upon Thee. He said: Thou wilt not see Me, but gaze upon the mountain! If it stand still in its place, then thou wilt see Me. And when his Lord revealed (His) glory to the mountain He sent it crashing down. And Moses fell down senseless. And when he woke he said: Glory unto Thee! I turn unto Thee repentant, and I am the first of (true) believers.

Ne zaman ki, Musa, mikatımıza geldi, Rabbi ona kelâmıyla ihsanda bulundu. "Ey Rabbim, göster bana kendini de bakayım sana". dedi. Rabbi ona buyurdu ki; "Beni katiyyen göremezsin ve lâkin dağa bak, eğer o yerinde durabilirse, sonra sen de beni göreceksin". Daha sonra Rabbi dağa tecelli edince onu yerle bir ediverdi, Musa da baygın düştü. Ayılıp kendine gelince, "Sen sübhansın", "tevbe ettim, sana döndüm ve ben inananların ilkiyim," dedi.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-A'raaf, 7:143. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And when Moses came at Our appointed time that is the time at which We had promised to speak to him and his Lord spoke with him without any intermediary with speech which he heard from all directions he said ‘My Lord! Show me Yourself that I may behold You!’ Said He ‘You shall not see Me that is to say you do not have the power to see me the use of this expression lan tarānī ‘you shall not see Me’ instead of lan urā ‘I shall not be seen’ implies that it is possible to see God exalted be He; but behold the mountain which is stronger than you are and if it remains stays fixed in its place then you shall see Me’ that is then you shall remain fixed able to see Me otherwise you will not have the capacity for it. And when his Lord revealed Himself that is when He manifested of His Light the equivalent of half a nail of a little finger as stated in one hadīth verified by al-Hākim to the mountain He levelled it to the ground read dakkan or dakkā’a meaning madkūkan and Moses fell down senseless having lost consciousness at the awesomeness of what he had seen. And when he recovered his senses he said ‘Glory be to You! in Your transcendence. I repent to You for having asked You what I was not commanded to ask and I am the first of the believers’ of my time.

en: longing for certainty rather than information

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِأَخِى وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِى رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِأَخِى وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِى رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ighfir lī wa-liʾakhī wa-ʾadkhilnā fī raḥmatika wa-ʾanta ʾarḥamu ar-rāḥimīna

translations.text: He said: My Lord! Have mercy on me and on my brother; bring us into Thy mercy, Thou the Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
Musa dedi ki: "Ey Rabbim! Beni ve kardeşimi bağışla! Bizi rahmetinin içine al. Sen merhametlilerin en merhametlisisin."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (7:151), Musa asks forgiveness for himself and his brother and seeks Allah’s mercy.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord forgive me what I have done to my brother and my brother he includes him in the supplication in order to reconcile him and to fend off any gloating over his misfortune and admit us into Your mercy for You are the Most Merciful of the merciful’.

reflection.text: Ask Allah’s mercy for yourself and those you love.

en: after being angry with a sibling
praying for someone you blamed unfairly
tr: haksız yere suçladığınız biri için dua ederken

excerpt.note: Both the narrative introduction and the closing narration are outside the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّٰىَ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهْدِى مَن تَشَآءُ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْغَٰفِرِينَ وَٱكْتُبْ لَنَا فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ
arabic.fullText: وَٱخْتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوْمَهُۥ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًۭا لِّمِيقَٰتِنَا فَلَمَّآ أَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّٰىَ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ مِنَّآ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَهْدِى مَن تَشَآءُ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْغَٰفِرِينَ وَٱكْتُبْ لَنَا فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنَّا هُدْنَآ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ عَذَابِىٓ أُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَنْ أَشَآءُ وَرَحْمَتِى وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَسَأَكْتُبُهَا لِلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi law shiʾta ʾahlaktahum min qablu wa-ʾiyyāya ʾatuhlikunā bimā fa-ʿala as-sufahāʾu minnā ʾin hiya ʾillā fitnatuka tuḍillu bihā man tashāʾu wa-tahdī man tashāʾu ʾanta wa-liyyunā faghfir lanā warḥamnā wa-ʾanta khayru al-ghāfirīna waktub lanā fī hādhihi ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa-fī al-ʾākhirati ʾinnā hudnā ʾilayka

translations.text: And Moses chose of his people seventy men for Our appointed tryst and, when the trembling came on them, he said: My Lord! If Thou hadst willed Thou hadst destroyed them long before, and me with them. Wilt thou destroy us for that which the ignorant among us did? It is but Thy trial (of us). Thou sendest whom Thou wilt astray and guidest whom Thou wilt: Thou art our Protecting Friend, therefore forgive us and have mercy on us, Thou, the Best of all who show forgiveness. And ordain for us in this world that which is good, and in the Hereafter (that which is good), Lo! We have turned unto Thee. He said: I smite with My punishment whom I will, and My mercy embraceth all things, therefore I shall ordain it for those who ward off (evil) and pay the poor-due, and those who believe Our revelations;

Bir de Musa, mîkatımız için (tayin ettiğimiz vakitte tevbe için) kavminden yetmiş erkek seçti. Ne zaman ki, bunları o sarsıntı yakaladı, işte o zaman Musa: "Rabbim! dedi, dileseydin bunları da, beni de daha önce helâk ederdin. Şimdi bizi, içimizdekio beyinsizlerin yaptıkları yüzünden helâk mi edeceksin? O iş de senin imtihanından başka bir şey değildi. Sen bu imtihanla dilediğini sapıklıkta bırakır, dilediğini de hidayete erdirirsin. Bizim velimiz sensin. Artık bizi bağışla, merhamet et, sen bağışlayanların en hayırlısısın." "Ve bize hem bu dünyada bir iyilik yaz, hem de ahirette. Biz gerçekten de tevbe edip senin hidayetine döndük." Buyurdu ki, azabım var, onu dilediğime isabet ettiririm, rahmetim de vardır, o ise her şeyi kaplamış ve kuşatmıştır. Onu da özellikle korunanlara, zekatını verenlere ve âyetlerimize inananlara mahsus kılacağım.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (7:156), Musa asks for goodness in this life and the Hereafter while turning to Allah.

tafsir.text: And Moses chose of his people seventy men from among those who had not worshipped the calf by God’s command for Our appointed time that is for the time at which We promised him that they should come and apologise for their comrades’ worship of the calf. He Moses then departed with them; but when the Trembling a violent earthquake seized them Ibn ‘Abbās said ‘That earthquake was because they did not separate themselves from their people when the latter took to worshipping the calf’; he Ibn ‘Abbās added ‘These people were not the same ones who asked to see God and were struck by the thunderbolt cf. Q. 255’ he Moses said ‘My Lord had You willed You would have destroyed them long before that is before my departure with them so that the Children of Israel might see this and not make false accusations against me and me with them. Will You destroy us for what the foolish ones among us have done? this interrogative is meant as a plea for compassion in other words ‘Do not punish us for the sins of others’. It that is the trial which the ignorant ones underwent is but Your trial Your test whereby You send astray whom You will to lead stray and guide whom You will to guide. You are our Protector looking after our affairs so forgive us and have mercy on us for You are the Best of all who show forgiveness.

reflection.text: Balance worldly needs with hope for the Hereafter.

en: answering for what people under you have done
when the foolish among you have cost everyone
tr: sorumlu olduğunuz kişilerin yaptığının hesabını verirken

title.en: I control none but myself and my brother
title.tr: Ben ancak kendime ve kardeşime söz geçirebiliyorum

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِى وَأَخِى فَٱفْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِى وَأَخِى فَٱفْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinnī lā ʾamliku ʾillā nafsī wa-ʾakhī fafruq baynanā wa-bayna al-qawmi al-fāsiqīna

translations.text: He said: My Lord! I have control of none but myself and my brother, so distinguish between us and the wrong-doing folk.
Musa: "Ey Rabbim! Ben, kendimle kardeşimden başkasına söz geçiremiyorum, artık bizimle bu fâsık kavmin arasını ayır" dedi.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Maaida, 5:25. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He Moses thereupon said ‘My Lord I control none but myself and my brother and I control no one else to be able to force them to obedience. So separate distinguish us from the wicked folk’.

en: leading people who will not follow
when you are responsible for an outcome you cannot control
