arabic.text: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُۥ زِينَةًۭ وَأَمْوَٰلًۭا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا ٱطْمِسْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَٱشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
arabic.fullText: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُۥ زِينَةًۭ وَأَمْوَٰلًۭا فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا ٱطْمِسْ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَٱشْدُدْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ʾinnaka ʾātayta firʿawna wa-malaʾahu zīnatan wa-ʾamwālan fī al-ḥayawāti ad-dunyā rabbanā liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlika rabbanā iṭmis ʿalā ʾamwālihim washdud ʿalā qulūbihim fa-lā yuʾminū ḥattā yarawu al-ʿadhāba al-ʾalīma

translations.text: And Moses said: Our Lord! Lo! Thou hast given Pharaoh and his chiefs splendour and riches in the life of the world, Our Lord! that they may lead men astray from Thy way. Our Lord! Destroy their riches and harden their hearts so that they believe not till they see the painful doom.

Musa dedi: "Ey Rabbimiz! Sen Firavun'a ve adamlarına şu dünya hayatında göz kamaştırıcı zenginlik ve bol bol servet verdin. Ey Rabbimiz! Senin yolundan saptırsınlar diye mi? Ey Rabbimiz! Onların mallarını sil süpür ve kalblerine sıkıntı düşür. Çünkü onlar o acıklı azabı görmedikçe iman etmeyecekler."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (10:88), Musa and Harun ask Allah to restrain Pharaoh’s misguidance and oppression.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And Moses said ‘Our Lord You have indeed given Pharaoh and his council splendour and riches in the life of this world. Our Lord You have given them this that they may lead people astray as a consequence thereof from Your way from Your religion. Our Lord obliterate transform their riches and harden their hearts stamp upon them and shackle them so that they do not believe until they see the painful chastisement’ he Moses invoked God against them and Aaron said ‘Amen’ at the end of his invocation.

reflection.text: Ask Allah to end wrongdoing and protect people from being led astray.

en: when wealth is being used to lead people away

title.en: Praise to the One who favoured us

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

transliteration.text: Al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin min ʿibādihi al-muʾminīna

translations.text: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!
Andolsun ki biz, Davud'a ve Süleyman'a bir ilim verdik. Onlar: "Bizi mümin kullarının birçoğundan üstün kılan Allah'a hamd olsun" dediler.

context.summary: From Sūrat An-Naml, 27:15. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And verily We gave David and Solomon his son knowledge of rendering decisive judgement between people and knowledge of the speech of birds and of other things and they said giving thanks to God ‘Praise be to God Who has favoured us with prophethood and the disposal of jinn humans and devils to our service over many of His believing servants’.

en: after being given an ability you did not earn
when knowledge comes easily and you notice it
tr: ilim kolay geldiğinde ve bunu fark ettiğinizde

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
arabic.fullText: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾawziʿnī ʾan ʾashkura niʿmataka allatī ʾanʿamta ʿalayya wa-ʿalā wālidayya wa-ʾan ʾaʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-ʾadkhilnī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādika aṣ-ṣāliḥīna

translations.text: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.
(Süleyman) onun sözüne gülümseyerek dedi ki: "Ey Rabbim! Bana ve ana babama verdiğin nimete şükretmemi ve hoşnut olacağın iyi iş yapmamı gönlüme getir. Rahmetinle, beni iyi kulların arasına kat."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (27:19), Sulaiman asks to be grateful and to do deeds pleasing to Allah.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Whereat he Solomon smiled fa-tabassama the beginning of the sentence amused dāhikan the end of the sentence at its words which he had heard from three miles away and which was carried to him by the winds. When he was on the verge of entering their valley he Solomon made his hosts halt until they the ants had entered their dwellings — on this journey his hosts consisted of cavalry and infantry. And he said ‘My Lord inspire me to be thankful for Your grace with which You have favoured me and my parents and to do good that will please You and include me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants’ the prophets and saints.

reflection.text: Pair gratitude with action that Allah loves.

en: when something small reminds you how much you have
after a success you did not earn alone
tr: küçük bir şey size ne kadar çok şeyiniz olduğunu hatırlattığında
tek başınıza kazanmadığınız bir başarıdan sonra

title.en: Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom
title.tr: Beni bağışla ve bana bir mülk ver

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ighfir lī wa-hab lī mulkan lā yanbaghī liʾaḥadin min baʿdī ʾinnaka ʾanta al-wahhābu

translations.text: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
Süleyman: "Ey Rabbim! Beni bağışla ve bana öyle bir mülk ihsan et ki, ardımdan hiç kimseye yaraşmasın. Şüphesiz, bütün dilekleri veren sensin." dedi.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (38:35), Sulaiman asks forgiveness and a unique kingdom by Allah’s gift.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord! Forgive me and grant me a kingdom that shall not belong to anyone after me in other words other than me this use of min ba‘dī to mean ‘other than me’ is similar to Q. 4523 fa-man yahdīh min ba‘di’Llāh ‘who will guide him other than God?’. Truly You are the Bestower’.

reflection.text: Seek Allah’s forgiveness even when granted power.

en: asking for something large without apologising for asking
tr: büyük bir şeyi istemekten çekinmeden isterken

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةًۭ طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
arabic.fullText: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةًۭ طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

transliteration.text: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan ʾinnaka samīʿu ad-duʿāʾi

translations.text: Then Zachariah prayed unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.
Orada Zekeriyya, Rabbine dua etti: "Rabbim! Bana katından hayırlı bir nesil ver. Şüphesiz sen, duayı hakkıyle işitensin" dedi.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (3:38), Zakariya asks Allah for good offspring.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Then when Zachariah had seen this and realised that the One with power to bring something about in other than its natural time is able to bring about a child in old age and with those of his family line all deceased Zachariah prayed to his Lord when he entered the sanctuary to pray in the middle of the night saying ‘Lord bestow upon me from You a goodly offspring a righteous son verily You are the Hearer of You are the One Who answers supplication’.

reflection.text: Ask Allah for righteous family and trust His timing.

en: trying for a child
after a loss
when the doctors have given a number

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
arabic.fullText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinnī wa-hana al-ʿaẓmu minnī washtaʿala ar-raʾsu shayban wa-lam ʾakun biduʿāʾika rabbi shaqiyyan wa-ʾinnī khiftu al-mawāliya min wa-rāʾī wa-kānati imraʾatī ʿāqiran fa-hab lī min ladunka wa-liyyan yarithunī wa-yarithu min ʾāli yaʿqūba wajʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan

translations.text: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord. Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).

Şöyle demişti: "Ey Rabbim! Şüphesiz (artık öyle bir durumdayım ki) benim kemiğim zayıflayıp gevşedi ve başım(ın saçı) bembeyaz alev gibi tutuştu. Sana dua etmekle de ey Rabbim, hiçbir zaman bedbaht olmadım." "Gerçekten ben, arkamdan yerime geçecek varislerden endişedeyim. Karım da kısır bulunuyor. Onun için katından bana bir çocuk ihsan et." "Ki bana da mirasçı olsun, Yakub ailesine de mirascı olsun. Rabbim, onu sen rızana kavuştur."

context.summary: In the Qur’an (19:5), Zakariya asks for a successor from Allah.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord truly the bones all the bones within me have become feeble weak and my head is alight with grey hair shayban a specification derived from the subject of the verb in other words hoariness has spread throughout his hairs just as a spark of fire spreads through firewood and I wish to supplicate to you and I have never been in my supplications to You my Lord unsuccessful that is I have never been disappointed in the past so do not disappoint me in what follows.

reflection.text: Pray for successors who preserve faith.

en: asking for something past the age of asking
when you fear what comes after you

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-ʾanta khayru al-wārithīna

translations.text: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.
Zekeriya da hani Rabbine: "Rabbim! Beni tek başıma bırakma, sen varislerin en hayırlısısın" diye nida etmişti.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (21:89), Zakariya asks not to be left without an heir.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And mention Zachariah Zakariyyā is substituted by the following idh nādā rabbahu … when he cried out to his Lord saying ‘My Lord do not leave me without an heir without a son to inherit from me and You are the best of inheritors’ the One that endures after all of your creation has perished.

reflection.text: Bring your deepest hopes to Allah with patience.

en: childlessness
loneliness that has no end in sight

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًۭا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

transliteration.text: Lā ʾilāha ʾillā ʾanta subḥānaka ʾinnī kuntu mina aẓ-ẓālimīna

translations.text: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.

Zünnun'u (balık sahibi Yunus'u) da hatırla. Hani o, öfkelenerek gitmişti de, bizim kendisini hiçbir zaman sıkıştırmayacağımızı sanmıştı. Fakat sonunda karanlıklar içinde: "Senden başka ilâh yoktur, sen münezzehsin, Şüphesiz ben haksızlık edenlerden oldum" diye seslenmişti.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (21:87), Yunus calls upon Allah, affirming tawhid and admitting his wrongdoing.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And mention Dhū’l-Nūn the one of the whale namely Jonah son of Amittai Yūnus bin Mattā when he went off enraged Dhā’l-Nūn is substituted by the clause idh dhahaba mughādiban by his people that is furious with them because of what he had suffered at their hands — even though he had not been granted permission by God to go off as he did — thinking that We had no power over him that is that We could not compel him to submit to Our decree in the way that We did by imprisoning him inside the stomach of the whale; or that We could not make circumstances difficult for him. Then he cried out in the darknesses through the darkness of the night the darkness of the sea and the darkness of the whale’s stomach that ‘There is no god except You! Glory be to You! I have indeed been one of the wrongdoers’ for leaving my people without Your permission.

reflection.text: In distress, return to Allah with tawhid and repentance.

en: when there is no way out and it is your own fault
at the lowest point
when you cannot find words of your own

title.en: Send down for us a table

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًۭا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةًۭ مِّنكَ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
arabic.fullText: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًۭا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةًۭ مِّنكَ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

transliteration.text: Al-lahumma rabbanā ʾanzil ʿalaynā māʾidatan mina as-samāʾi takūnu lanā ʿīdan liʾawwalinā wa-ʾākhirinā wa-ʾāyatan minka warzuqnā wa-ʾanta khayru ar-rāziqīna

translations.text: Jesus, son of Mary, said: O Allah, Lord of us! Send down for us a table spread with food from heaven, that it may be a feast for us, for the first of us and for the last of us, and a sign from Thee. Give us sustenance, for Thou art the Best of Sustainers.

Meryemoğlu İsa da: "Allah'ım, Rabbımız, bizim üzerimize gökten bir sofra indir ki, bizim için, önce ve sonra gelenlerimiz için bir bayram ve senden bir mucize olsun. Bizi rızıklandır, sen rızık verenlerin en hayırlısısın!" dedi.

context.summary: In the Qur’an (5:114), Isa supplicates for a table from heaven as a sign and provision.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Jesus son of Mary said ‘O God our Lord send down upon us a Table from the heaven that it shall be that is the day of its sending down shall be a celebration for us which we shall consecrate and honour for the first li-awwalinā is an inclusive substitution for lanā ‘for us’ with the repetition of the oblique preposition li- and the last of us those who will come after us and a sign from You of Your power and my prophethood. And provide it for us; You are the Best of Providers’.

reflection.text: Ask Allah for provision with gratitude and awareness of His signs.

en: asking for food or means for people depending on you
tr: size bağlı insanlar için rızık ya da imkân isterken

arabic.text: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
arabic.fullText: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

transliteration.text: ʾin tuʿadhdhibhum fa-ʾinnahum ʿibāduka wa-ʾin taghfir lahum fa-ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ʿazīzu al-ḥakīmu

translations.text: If Thou punish them, lo! they are Thy slaves, and if Thou forgive them (lo! they are Thy slaves). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise.
"Eğer onlara azab edersen, onlar senin kullarındır, eğer onları bağışlarsan, şüphesiz sen daima üstünsün, hikmet sahibisin".

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Maaida, 5:118. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: If you chastise them that is those among them who are fixed upon disbelief verily they are Your servants and You are their Master disposing of them as You will there can be no objection to what You do; and if You forgive them that is those of them who are believers You only You are the Mighty in His affair the Wise’ in His actions.

en: praying for people who have gone wrong and are not yours to judge
tr: yoldan çıkmış ve hükmü size ait olmayan insanlar için dua ederken

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا
arabic.fullText: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا

transliteration.text: Rabbi zidnī ʿilman

translations.text: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.

Hükmü her yerde geçerli gerçek hükümdar olan Allah yücedir. (Ey Muhammed!) Kur'ân sana vahyedilirken, vahiy bitmeden önce (unutma korkusu ile) Kur'ân'ı okumada acele etme; "Rabbim! benim ilmimi artır" de.

context.summary: From Sūrat Taa-Haa, 20:114. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: So exalted be God the King the Truth above what the idolaters say. And do not hasten with the Qur’ān that is to recite it before its revelation is completed for you before Gabriel is through delivering it and say ‘My Lord increase me in knowledge’ that is knowledge of the Qur’ān thus every time something of it was revealed to him his knowledge increased because of it.

en: before studying
when you notice how much you do not know
tr: ne kadar az bildiğinizi fark ettiğinizde

title.en: A sound entrance and a sound exit

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍۢ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍۢ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًۭا نَّصِيرًۭا
arabic.fullText: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍۢ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍۢ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًۭا نَّصِيرًۭا

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾadkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqin wa-ʾakhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqin wajʿal lī min ladunka sulṭānan naṣīran

translations.text: And say: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power.
(Ey Muhammed!) De ki: "Rabbim! Beni, takdir ettiğin yere gönül rahatlığı ve huzur içinde koy ve çıkacağım yerden de dürüstlükle ve selametle çıkmamı sağla. Bana katından yardım edici bir kuvvet ver."

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Israa, 17:80. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And say ‘My Lord make me enter Medina with a veritable entrance an entrance that is satisfying one in which I do not see what I dislike and bring me out of Mecca with a veritable departure a departure such that my heart will not care to turn back to look at it yearningly. And grant me from Yourself a favourable authority’ grant me strength with which You render me victorious over Your enemies.

en: starting a new job
leaving a place for the last time
travelling

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ighfir warḥam wa-ʾanta khayru ar-rāḥimīna

translations.text: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
Resulüm! De ki: "Rabbim, bağışla ve merhamet et! Sen merhametlilerin en iyisisin."

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Muminoon, 23:118. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And say ‘My Lord forgive and have mercy on believers — this ‘mercy’ adds to the ‘forgiveness’ in terms of God’s grace — and You are the best of the merciful’ the most excellent of those who have mercy.

en: when you want to ask for everything in the fewest words
tr: en az kelimeyle her şeyi istemek istediğinizde

title.en: Mercy from Yourself, and right guidance

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا
arabic.fullText: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ʾātinā min ladunka raḥmatan wa-hayyiʾ lanā min ʾamrinā rashadan

translations.text: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave and said: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.
O gençler mağaraya sığınınca şöyle dediler: "Rabbimiz! Bize katından bir rahmet ver ve bizim için şu işimizden bir kurtuluş yolu hazırla."

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Kahf, 18:10. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Mention when the youths took refuge in the Cave fitya ‘youths’ is the plural of fatā and denotes a mature young man fearing for their faith from their disbelieving people they said ‘Our Lord! Give us mercy from Yourself and remedy for us our affair through rectitude’ through Your guidance.

en: leaving a situation without knowing where you are going
when belief costs you your place
tr: nereye gittiğinizi bilmeden bir durumu terk ederken

title.en: Build for me a house with You

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ibni lī ʿindaka baytan fī al-jannati wa-najjinī min firʿawna wa-ʿamalihi wa-najjinī mina al-qawmi aẓ-ẓālimīna

translations.text: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;

Allah, inananlara da Firavun'un karısını örnek gösterdi. O şöyle demişti: "Rabbim! Bana yanında cennetin içinde bir ev yap, beni Firavun'dan ve onun (kötü) işinden kurtar. Ve beni şu zalim toplumdan kurtar!"

context.summary: From Sūrat At-Tahrim, 66:11. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: And God has struck a similitude for those who believe the wife of Pharaoh — she believed in Moses her name was Āsiya; Pharaoh chastised her by tying her hands and feet to pegs and placing a huge millstone on her chest and having her laid out in the sun; but when those in charge of her would leave her the angels would come to shade her — when she said during her torture ‘My Lord build for me a home near You in Paradise — so He disclosed for her a veil of the Unseen and she saw it which in turn alleviated for her the torture — and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work his torture and deliver me from the evildoing folk’ the followers of his Pharaoh’s religion whereat God took unto Himself her spirit in death. Ibn Kaysān said ‘She was raised to Paradise alive where she eats and drinks’.

en: trapped in a household you cannot leave
when the person harming you is the person you live with
tr: size zarar veren kişi birlikte yaşadığınız kişiyken

title.en: I have vowed to You what is in my womb

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
arabic.fullText: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

transliteration.text: Rabbi ʾinnī nadhartu laka mā fī baṭnī muḥarraran fa-taqabbal minnī ʾinnaka ʾanta as-samīʿu al-ʿalīmu

translations.text: (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: My Lord! I have vowed unto Thee that which is in my belly as a consecrated (offering). Accept it from me. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower!
İmran'ın karısı: "Rabbim, karnımdakini tam hür olarak sana adadım, benden kabul buyur, şüphesiz sen işitensin, bilensin." demişti.

context.summary: From Sūrat Aal-i-Imraan, 3:35. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Mention when the wife of ‘Imrān Hanna said after she had reached old age and longed for a child and supplicated to God and sensed that she was carrying child ‘O Lord I have vowed to offer You what is within my womb as a consecration one liberated and delivered from the distractions of this world for the service of Your Holy House in Jerusalem. Accept this from me. Lo! It is You Who are the Hearer of petition the Knower of intentions. ‘Imrān died while she was still pregnant.

en: during pregnancy
dedicating something before you know how it will turn out

title.en: I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
arabic.fullText: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا

transliteration.text: ʾinnī ʾaʿūdhu bilrraḥmāni minka ʾin kunta taqiyyan

translations.text: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
Meryem: "Ben senden Rahmân (olan Allah) a sığınırım. Eğer Allah'dan korkuyorsan (dokunma bana)" dedi.

context.summary: From Sūrat Maryam, 19:18. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: She said ‘Lo! I seek refuge in the Compassionate One from you! If you fear God’ and leave me alone on account of my invocation of refuge in God.

en: alone with someone you do not trust
when you need a first sentence that ends it
tr: meseleyi bitirecek ilk cümleye ihtiyaç duyduğunuzda

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًۭا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَمَا تَنقِمُ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا لَمَّا جَآءَتْنَا رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًۭا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ʾafrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa-tawaffanā muslimīna

translations.text: Thou takest vengeance on us only forasmuch as we believed the tokens of our Lord when they came unto us. Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee).
"Senin bize kızman da sırf Rabbimizin âyetleri gelince onlara iman etmemizden dolayıdır. Ey Rabbimiz! Üzerimize sabır yağdır ve canımızı müslüman olarak al." derler.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-A'raaf, 7:126. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: You are vindictive spiteful towards us only because we have believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord pour out onto us patience and constancy when that with which he has threatened us comes to pass lest we revert to unbelief; and take us to You as men who have submitted’.

en: when holding to what you believe will cost you badly
facing a punishment you accepted knowingly
tr: inandığınızda direnmek size ağır bir bedele mal olacakken
bile bile kabul ettiğiniz bir cezayla yüzleşirken

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًۭا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًۭا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ʾafrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa-thabbit ʾaqdāmanā wa-inṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-kāfirīna

translations.text: And when they went into the field against Goliath and his hosts they said: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.
Calut ve ordusuna karşı savaş meydanına çıktıkları zaman da şöyle dediler: "Ey Rabbimiz! Üzerlerimize sabır dök, ayaklarımızı sabit tut ve kâfirler topluluğuna karşı bize yardım et!"

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Baqara, 2:250. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: So when they went forth against Goliath and his troops facing them in military columns they said ‘Our Lord pour out upon us patience and make firm our feet by strengthening our hearts for this struggle and grant us victory over the disbelieving folk!’

en: outnumbered
before something you expect to lose

title.en: Do not take us to task if we forget

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
arabic.fullText: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā ʾin nasīnā ʾaw ʾakhṭaʾnā rabbanā wa-lā taḥmil ʿalaynā ʾiṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablinā rabbanā wa-lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā ʾanta mawlānā fa-inṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-kāfirīna

translations.text: Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

Allah hiç kimseye gücünün yeteceğinden başka yük yüklemez. Herkesin kazandığı hayır kendisine, yaptığı kötülüğün zararı yine kendisinedir. Ey Rabbimiz, eğer unuttuk ya da yanıldıysak bizi tutup sorguya çekme! Ey Rabbimiz, bize bizden öncekilere yüklediğin gibi ağır yük yükleme! Ey Rabbimiz, bize gücümüzün yetmeyeceği yükü de yükleme! Bağışla bizi, mağfiret et bizi, rahmet et bize! Sensin bizim Mevlamız, kâfir kavimlere karşı yardım et bize.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Baqara, 2:286. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: God charges no soul save to its capacity that is what it is capable of bearing; for it is what it has merited of good and its reward and against it is what it has earned of evil and its burden no person shall be requited for another’s sin or for what he has not earned even if he was tempted to do it. Say Our Lord take us not to task by way of chastisement if we forget or err by straying from the right path unknowingly — as You used to take to task those before us God has lifted this burden from this community as reported in hadīth. The petition here then is a way of acknowledging God’s favour; our Lord burden us not with a load an affair which we cannot bear such as You did lay upon those before us namely upon the Children of Israel as for example the killing of oneself in repentance the paying of a quarter of one’s property for alms and the severing of the impure part. Our Lord do not burden us beyond what we have the power the strength to bear of obligations and trials; and pardon us effacing our sins and forgive us and have mercy on us with mercy added to Your forgiveness; You are our Patron our Master and the Guardian of our affairs; so grant us assistance against the disbelieving folk by establishing definitive proof for us and victory over them in battle for it is expected of a patron that he assist his clients against their enemies. In a hadīth it is stated that when this verse was revealed and the Prophet s was reciting it after each word it was said to him “Granted”.

en: at the end of the day
when you are carrying more than you can hold
before sleep

title.en: Do not let our hearts deviate

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
arabic.fullText: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda ʾidh hadaytanā wa-hab lanā min ladunka raḥmatan ʾinnaka ʾanta al-wahhābu

translations.text: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.
Ey Rabbimiz! Bize ihsan ettiğin hidayetten sonra kalblerimizi haktan saptırma, bize kendi katından rahmet ihsan eyle! Şüphesiz ki, Sen bol ihsan sahibisin.

context.summary: From Sūrat Aal-i-Imraan, 3:8. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: Our Lord do not cause our hearts to deviate do not cause them to incline away from the truth in their desire to interpret it such as is inappropriate for us — as You caused the hearts of those others to deviate — after You have guided us after You have shown us the way to it; and give us mercy from You as a strengthening; You are the Bestower.

en: after finding something you do not want to lose
when you fear your own drift
tr: kaybetmek istemediğiniz bir şey bulduktan sonra

excerpt.note: Opens mid-āyah; the narrative introduction is not part of the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
arabic.fullText: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

transliteration.text: Rabbanā ighfir lanā dhunūbanā wa-ʾisrāfanā fī ʾamrinā wa-thabbit ʾaqdāmanā wa-inṣurnā ʿalā al-qawmi al-kāfirīna

translations.text: Their cry was only that they said: Our Lord! forgive us for our sins and wasted efforts, make our foothold sure, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.
Onların sözleri ancak: "Rabbimiz! Bizim günahlarımızı ve işlerimizdeki taşkınlıklarımızı bağışla ve (yolunda) ayaklarımızı diret, Kâfirler güruhuna karşı da bize yardım et!" demekten ibaretti.

context.summary: From Sūrat Aal-i-Imraan, 3:147. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: All that they said when their prophet had been killed while they stood their ground and were steadfast was ‘Our Lord forgive us our sins and our excesses our overstepping the bounds in our affairs a declaration of the fact that what had befallen them was the result of their evil actions and a humbling of their selves and make firm our feet with strength for the struggle and help us against the unbelieving folk’.

en: after a setback that was partly your own doing
when you need to keep going anyway
tr: kısmen kendi hatanızdan kaynaklanan bir aksilikten sonra

excerpt.note: Opens after the verb of speech introducing the supplication.

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
arabic.fullText: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

transliteration.text: Rabbanā hab lanā min ʾazwājinā wa-dhurriyyātinā qurrata ʾaʿyunin wajʿalnā lilmuttaqīna ʾimāman

translations.text: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
Ve onlar ki: "Ey Rabbimiz! Bize gözümüzü aydınlatacak eşler ve zürriyetler bağışla ve bizi takva sahiplerine önder kıl" derler.

context.summary: From Sūrat Al-Furqaan, 25:74. The occasion of this supplication has not yet been written with a tafsīr citation.

tafsir.author: al-Maḥallī and al-Suyūṭī
tafsir.licence: Royal Aal al-Bayt Institute — freely distributed, attribution required
tafsir.text: and those who say ‘Our Lord! Grant us in our spouses and our offspring read plural dhurriyyātinā or singular dhurriyyatinā a joyful sight for us so that we see them obedient to You and make us paragons of virtue for the God-fearing’.

en: praying for a spouse and children
when you want your family to be a source of rest
tr: eş ve çocuklar için dua ederken
ailenizin bir huzur kaynağı olmasını istediğinizde

arabic.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

transliteration.text: Al-lahumma ʾinnī ẓalamtu nafsī ẓulman kathīran wa-lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba ʾillā ʾanta fa-ghfir lī maghfiratan min ʿindika wa-rḥamnī ʾinnaka ʾanta al-ghafūru ar-raḥīmu

translations.text: Allah’ım! Kendime çok zulmettim; günahları ancak Sen bağışlarsın. Beni bağışla ve bana merhamet et; Sen çok bağışlayan, çok merhamet edensin.
O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You. So forgive me with forgiveness from Yourself, and have mercy on me. You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

context.summary: In Sahih al-Bukhari (834), the Prophet ﷺ taught Abu Bakr to say this in prayer when seeking forgiveness and mercy.

en: in prayer, before the closing salām
when you want words the Prophet ﷺ taught directly
tr: Peygamber'in ﷺ bizzat öğrettiği kelimeleri istediğinizde

arabic.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ

transliteration.text: Al-lahumma ʾinnī ʾaʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi jahannama wa-min ʿadhābi al-qabri wa-min fitnati al-maḥyā wa-al-mamāti wa-min sharri fitnati al-masīḥi ad-dajjāli

translations.text: Allah’ım! Cehennem azabından, kabir azabından, hayat ve ölüm fitnelerinden ve Deccal fitnesinin şerrinden Sana sığınırım.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell, from the punishment of the grave, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.

context.summary: In Sahih Muslim (843), the Prophet ﷺ instructed this supplication for protection from major trials and punishments in prayer.

en: in prayer, before the closing salām

title.en: Set right my religion, my world, my end

arabic.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِيَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي

transliteration.text: Al-lahumma ʾaṣliḥ lī dīniya alladhī huwa ʿiṣmatu ʾamrī wa-ʾaṣliḥ lī dunyāya allatī fīhā maʿāshī wa-ʾaṣliḥ lī ʾākhiratiya allatī fīhā maʿādī

translations.text: Allah’ım! İşlerimin teminatı olan dinimi düzelt; geçimimin olduğu dünyamı düzelt; dönüşümün olduğu ahiretimi de düzelt.
O Allah, set right for me my religion, which is the safeguard of my affairs; and set right for me my worldly life, in which is my livelihood; and set right for me my Hereafter, to which is my return.

context.summary: In Sahih Muslim (2720), it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ would supplicate for rectification of religion, worldly life, and the Hereafter.

en: when several parts of your life need attention at once
when you do not know which thing to fix first
tr: hayatınızın birkaç alanı aynı anda ilgi istediğinde

title.tr: Hidayet, takva, iffet ve gönül zenginliği

arabic.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى

transliteration.text: Al-lahumma ʾinnī ʾasʾaluka al-hudā wa-at-tuqā wa-al-ʿafāfa wa-al-ghinā

translations.text: Allah’ım! Senden hidayet, takva, iffet ve gönül zenginliği dilerim.
O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

context.summary: In Sahih Muslim (2721), it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ would ask for guidance, piety, chastity, and contentment.

en: a short duʿāʾ to keep
when you want to ask for the whole of it in four words
tr: her şeyi dört kelimeyle istemek istediğinizde

arabic.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

transliteration.text: Al-lahumma ʾinnī ʾaʿūdhu bika mina al-hammi wa-al-ḥazani wa-al-ʿajzi wa-al-kasali wa-al-bukhli wa-al-jubni wa-ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa-ghalabati ar-rijāli

translations.text: Allah’ım! Hüzün ve kederden, acizlik ve tembellikten, cimrilik ve korkaklıktan, borç yükünden ve insanların baskısından Sana sığınırım.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

context.summary: In Sahih al-Bukhari (6369), it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge from anxiety, laziness, and overpowering debt.

en: in debt
worn down and unable to start
when worry has become the background of the day

source.note: The best-known penitential psalm, traditionally attributed to David. Outside the Qurʾān and the Sunnah, with no Islamic chain of transmission — included because the Qurʾān records that Dāwūd sought forgiveness (38:24) without quoting his words.

translations.text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.
Ey Allah'ım, lütfunla bana merhamet et. Rahmetinin çokluğuyla isyanlarımı sil. Beni kötülüğümden tamamen yıka ve günahımdan arındır.

context.summary: The best-known penitential psalm, traditionally attributed to David. Outside the Qurʾān and the Sunnah, with no Islamic chain of transmission — included because the Qurʾān records that Dāwūd sought forgiveness (38:24) without quoting his words.

en: after a wrong you cannot undo
when asking to be washed rather than excused

summary.en: The first human being and the first prophet. Taught the names of all things, settled in the Garden, and removed from it after eating from the forbidden tree.
summary.tr: İlk insan ve ilk peygamber. Kendisine bütün isimler öğretildi, cennete yerleştirildi ve yasaklanan ağaçtan yedikten sonra oradan çıkarıldı.

trial.en: Having done the one thing he was told not to do, and answering for it without excuse.
trial.tr: Yapmaması söylenen tek şeyi yapmak ve bunun hesabını mazeret üretmeden vermek.

summary.en: Called his people for 950 years and was believed by few. Built the ark on command and was carried through the flood with those who followed him.
summary.tr: Kavmini 950 yıl davet etti ve pek azı ona inandı. Emir üzerine gemiyi yaptı ve kendisine uyanlarla birlikte tufandan geçirildi.

trial.en: A lifetime of work with almost nothing to show for it, and a son among those who refused.
trial.tr: Neredeyse hiçbir karşılık görmeden geçen bir ömür ve reddedenler arasında bir oğul.

summary.en: Broke with his people's idols, was cast into a fire he survived, and left his wife and infant son in an empty valley on command. Raised the foundations of the House with Ismāʿīl.
summary.tr: Kavminin putlarından ayrıldı, atıldığı ateşten sağ çıktı ve emir üzerine hanımı ile bebek oğlunu ıssız bir vadide bıraktı. İsmâil ile birlikte Kâbe'nin temellerini yükseltti.

trial.en: Being asked, repeatedly, to give up the thing he had waited longest for.
trial.tr: En uzun beklediği şeyden vazgeçmesinin defalarca istenmesi.

summary.en: Sent to a people whose public conduct he opposed alone. Delivered with his household, except his wife.
summary.tr: Açıkça sürdürdükleri davranışa tek başına karşı çıktığı bir kavme gönderildi. Hanımı dışında ailesiyle birlikte kurtarıldı.

trial.en: Standing against an entire town, with his own household divided.
trial.tr: Kendi evi bölünmüşken bütün bir şehre karşı durmak.

summary.en: Father of Yūsuf. Lost him to his brothers' deception and wept until his sight went, saying he complained of his grief to Allah alone. His sight returned when word of his son came.
summary.tr: Yûsuf'un babası. Oğlunu kardeşlerinin hilesiyle kaybetti; gözleri ağlamaktan görmez oldu ve kederini yalnız Allah'a arz ettiğini söyledi. Oğlundan haber gelince gözleri yeniden açıldı.

trial.en: Grief carried without complaint to anyone but Allah.
trial.tr: Allah'tan başkasına şikâyet edilmeden taşınan bir keder.

summary.en: Thrown into a well by his brothers, sold into service, imprisoned on a false accusation, and raised to authority over the treasuries of Egypt.
summary.tr: Kardeşleri tarafından kuyuya atıldı, köle olarak satıldı, iftirayla hapsedildi ve Mısır'ın hazinelerinin başına getirildi.

trial.en: Being punished for the thing he refused to do.

summary.en: Afflicted in his body and separated from his family, and remembered for the patience with which he bore it. The Qurʾān says he was found steadfast.
summary.tr: Bedeninde bir dertle imtihan edildi ve ailesinden ayrı düştü; bunu taşıdığı sabırla anılır. Kur'ân onu sabreden biri olarak nitelendirir.

trial.en: Prolonged illness — the kind that outlasts other people's sympathy.
trial.tr: Uzayan hastalık — başkalarının merhametinden daha uzun süren cinsten.

summary.en: Sent to Madyan, calling his people to honest weights and measures and to leave off cheating in trade.
summary.tr: Medyen'e gönderildi; kavmini ölçü ve tartıda dürüstlüğe, ticarette hile bırakmaya çağırdı.

trial.en: Being threatened with expulsion for refusing to return to what he had left.
trial.tr: Terk ettiği şeye dönmeyi reddettiği için sürgünle tehdit edilmek.

summary.en: Raised in Pharaoh's household, fled Egypt after a killing he did not intend, and was sent back to the man who had raised him. Spoken to directly by Allah.
summary.tr: Firavun'un sarayında büyüdü, kastetmediği bir ölümün ardından Mısır'dan kaçtı ve kendisini büyüten adama geri gönderildi. Allah kendisiyle doğrudan konuştu.

trial.en: Being sent back to the household he had fled, to confront the most powerful ruler of his time.
trial.tr: Kaçtığı saraya geri gönderilip zamanının en güçlü hükümdarının karşısına çıkarılmak.

summary.en: Given the Zabūr, the mountains and birds joining him in praise. Killed Jālūt as a young man and was given kingship and sound judgement.
summary.tr: Kendisine Zebûr verildi; dağlar ve kuşlar tesbihine katıldı. Gençliğinde Câlût'u öldürdü, ona hükümdarlık ve isabetli hüküm verildi.

trial.en: Holding power and judging between people while remaining answerable himself.
trial.tr: İktidarı elinde tutup insanlar arasında hüküm verirken kendisinin de hesap verecek olması.

summary.en: Son of Dāwūd. Given understanding of the speech of birds and authority over the wind and the jinn, and a kingdom he asked would belong to no one after him.
summary.tr: Dâvûd'un oğlu. Kendisine kuş dilini anlama, rüzgâra ve cinlere hükmetme ve kendisinden sonra kimseye nasip olmayacak bir mülk verildi.

trial.en: Being given everything, and having to stay grateful for it.
trial.tr: Her şeyin verilmiş olması ve buna şükreder kalabilmek.

summary.en: Left his people in anger before he was permitted to, was swallowed by the fish, and called out from inside the darknesses. Returned to a people who then believed.
summary.tr: İzin verilmeden önce kavmini öfkeyle terk etti, balık tarafından yutuldu ve karanlıkların içinden seslendi. Sonra iman eden bir kavme geri döndü.

trial.en: Being entirely alone, in the dark, in a situation he had walked into himself.
trial.tr: Kendi adımlarıyla girdiği bir durumda, karanlıkta, tamamen yalnız kalmak.

summary.en: Guardian of Maryam. Childless into old age, he asked for an heir and was given Yaḥyā when his wife was barren and his bones had weakened.
summary.tr: Meryem'in hâmisi. Yaşlılığına kadar çocuğu olmadı; bir vâris istedi ve hanımı kısır, kemikleri gevşemişken kendisine Yahyâ verildi.

trial.en: Wanting a child past the age when wanting one is reasonable.
trial.tr: Evlat istemenin artık makul olmadığı bir yaşta evlat istemek.

summary.en: Born to Maryam without a father and spoke from the cradle. Given the Injīl, and raised to Allah rather than killed.
summary.tr: Meryem'den babasız dünyaya geldi ve beşikte konuştu. Kendisine İncil verildi ve öldürülmeyip Allah'a yükseltildi.

trial.en: Being answerable for what people would later say about him.
trial.tr: İnsanların sonradan kendisi hakkında söyleyeceklerinden sorumlu tutulmak.

summary.en: The final Prophet, to whom the Qurʾān was revealed over twenty-three years. Orphaned young, driven from Mecca, and returned to it.
summary.tr: Kendisine Kur'ân'ın yirmi üç yılda indirildiği son peygamber. Küçük yaşta yetim kaldı, Mekke'den çıkarıldı ve oraya geri döndü.

trial.en: Losing, in a single year, both the wife who believed him first and the uncle who protected him.
trial.tr: Tek bir yıl içinde hem kendisine ilk inanan hanımını hem de onu koruyan amcasını kaybetmek.

references.author: Ibn Hishām
references.locus: on the year of Khadīja's and Abū Ṭālib's deaths

summary.en: Young men who withdrew to a cave rather than abandon their belief, and were kept there for years.
summary.tr: İnançlarından vazgeçmektense bir mağaraya çekilen ve orada yıllarca tutulan gençler.

summary.en: The wife of Pharaoh, who believed while living in his house, and asked for a home with Allah instead of the one she had.
summary.tr: Firavun'un hanımı; onun sarayında yaşarken iman etti ve sahip olduğu evin yerine Allah katında bir ev istedi.

summary.en: The wife of ʿImrān, who vowed the child in her womb to Allah's service and was given a daughter instead of the son she expected.
summary.tr: İmrân'ın hanımı; karnındaki çocuğu Allah'a adadı ve beklediği oğul yerine kendisine bir kız verildi.

summary.en: Chosen and purified above the women of the worlds. Mother of ʿĪsā, who bore an accusation she could not answer except by pointing to her child.
summary.tr: Âlemlerin kadınlarına üstün kılınan ve arındırılan Meryem. Îsâ'nın annesi; çocuğunu göstermekten başka cevap veremeyeceği bir iftirayı taşıdı.

summary.en: Brought to defeat Mūsā, they recognised what they saw, believed on the spot, and accepted execution rather than retract.
summary.tr: Mûsâ'yı yenmek için getirildiler; gördüklerini tanıdılar, orada iman ettiler ve sözlerinden dönmektense idamı kabul ettiler.

summary.en: Supplications the Qurʾān gives to be said, rather than quoting from a named speaker. They are here because they belong on a complete site, and separate because attributing them to a prophet would overstate the text.
summary.tr: Kur'ân'ın belirli bir söyleyenden nakletmek yerine söylenmek üzere verdiği dualar. Eksiksiz bir derlemeye ait oldukları için buradalar; bir peygambere nispet etmek metnin ötesine geçeceği için de ayrı tutuldular.

summary.en: The small band who crossed the river with Ṭālūt and faced Jālūt's army. Dāwūd was among them, but the duʿāʾ is theirs collectively.
summary.tr: Tâlût ile nehri geçip Câlût'un ordusuyla yüzleşen küçük topluluk. Dâvûd da aralarındaydı, ancak dua topluca onlarındır.

label.en: When there seems no way out

description.en: Trapped, cornered, out of options — the duʿāʾ said from inside the difficulty rather than after it.
description.tr: Sıkışmış, köşeye kısılmış, seçenekleri tükenmiş hâldeyken — zorluğun ardından değil, tam içindeyken edilen dualar.

description.en: Turning back after a mistake, without excuses and without despair.
description.tr: Bir hatanın ardından, mazeret üretmeden ve ümit kesmeden dönüş.

description.en: Loss, separation, and sorrow that does not lift on schedule.
description.tr: Kayıp, ayrılık ve zamanla dinmeyen keder.

description.en: Facing something or someone you have reason to fear — before it happens, not after.
description.tr: Korkmakta haklı olduğunuz bir şeyle yüzleşirken — olaydan sonra değil, öncesinde.

label.en: When you or someone you love is ill
label.tr: Siz ya da sevdiğiniz biri hastalandığında

description.en: Sickness, pain, and long affliction borne without complaint against the One who sent it.
description.tr: Hastalık, ağrı ve onu gönderene şikâyet etmeden taşınan uzun ıstırap.

description.en: Hunger, debt, work, shelter — asking for what sustains you without naming a figure.
description.tr: Açlık, borç, iş, barınak — bir miktar belirtmeden geçiminizi istemek.

label.en: When you long for a child

description.en: Childlessness, and prayers for offspring — including those made long past the age of expecting.
description.tr: Evlatsızlık ve zürriyet duaları — ümidin çoktan tükendiği yaşlarda edilenler dâhil.

label.en: For your parents and your family

description.en: Praying for the people you are bound to — parents, spouse, descendants, household.
description.tr: Bağlı olduğunuz insanlar için dua: anne baba, eş, zürriyet, hane halkı.

description.en: A choice you cannot see the end of, and the request to be shown rather than told.
description.tr: Sonunu göremediğiniz bir tercih ve söylenmek yerine gösterilmeyi isteme.

description.en: Study, memorisation, teaching, and the honest admission of not knowing.
description.tr: İlim, ezber, öğretmek ve bilmediğini dürüstçe kabul etmek.

label.en: When the task is beyond you

description.en: Being sent to do something you do not feel equal to, and asking for capacity rather than escape.
description.tr: Kendinizi yeterli hissetmediğiniz bir işle görevlendirildiğinizde, kaçış değil güç istemek.

description.en: Oppression, slander, and power used against you — taking it to Allah instead of into your own hands.
description.tr: Zulüm, iftira ve aleyhinize kullanılan güç — meseleyi kendi elinize almak yerine Allah'a götürmek.

description.en: Seeking refuge — from harm, from people, from what you cannot see, and from yourself.
description.tr: Sığınma: zarardan, insanlardan, göremediğinizden ve kendinizden.

description.en: Standing on something at cost — asking to be poured patience rather than to be spared the test.
description.tr: Bir şeyin arkasında bedel ödeyerek durmak — imtihandan muaf tutulmayı değil, sabır dökülmesini istemek.

label.en: When you want to give thanks

description.en: After the thing you asked for arrived — the prayer that is easiest to forget.
description.tr: İstediğiniz şey geldikten sonra — unutulması en kolay dua.

label.en: When you think of the end

description.en: Death, the reckoning, and asking to be gathered with the righteous.
description.tr: Ölüm, hesap ve salihlerle birlikte haşredilmeyi istemek.
